comments.text:
Implement tone editor shell in Vizia with sub-editors for all 5 tone types.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.10 (EqSection), i7-49c.11 (ADSR), i7-49c.13 (MixerPage — for navigation)

This is the largest single task. Build incrementally: start with the SN-S editor (simplest, 3 partials), then SN-A, SN-D, PCM-S, PCM-D.

EDITOR SHELL:
- Detects tone type from the selected part's bank MSB (87=PCM-S, 89=SN-A, 95=SN-S, 86=PCM-D, 88=SN-D)
- Loads tone data via RQ1 requests to the appropriate tone block addresses
- Displays the correct sub-editor

SN-S EDITOR (reference: web/src/SnSynthEditor.tsx + web/src/sn-synth/*.tsx):
- Common strip: unison, mono, portamento, bend range, wave shape, tone level, analog feel, legato, octave shift
- 3 partial rows, each with: OSC panel, Filter panel, Amp panel, Mod LFO panel, LFO panel
- MFX sidebar

SN-A EDITOR (reference: web/src/SnAcousticEditor.tsx):
- Common strip, instrument-specific parameter panel, MFX

SN-D EDITOR (reference: web/src/SnDrumEditor.tsx):
- Key grid, per-key: instrument selector, level/pan/send strip, note params, MFX

PCM-S EDITOR (reference: web/src/PcmSynthEditor.tsx + web/src/pcm-synth/*.tsx):
- Common strip, PMT strip, 4 partial rows (Wave, Pitch, TVF, TVA, LFO1, LFO2, Step LFO, Output), MFX

PCM-D EDITOR (reference: web/src/PcmDrumEditor.tsx + web/src/pcm-drum/*.tsx):
- Common panel, key grid, per-key: WMT (4 layers), pitch env, TVF, TVA, misc, MFX

title: VST/Vizia: implement tone editor shell with SN-S, SN-A, SN-D, PCM-S, PCM-D editors
